definition: A hidden feeling or influence beneath what is openly shown.
author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
quote: With all his cruel ferocity and coldness there was an undercurrent of something in Tars Tarkas which he seemed ever battling to subdue.
example_sentence: There was an undercurrent of tension at the family dinner.
